name: poi-command-photo-ops
note: poi_store Command: op export_photos, replace.photo_dir, replace result counts (photos_replaced, photos_removed)

name: poi-clear-photo-kind
note: poi_store Command.kinds includes photo; clear result {removed, pois, photos}

name: poi-list-photo-entries
note: /poi/list carries photo POIs (photo_as_poi form, x/y may be null) after non-photo POIs; one revision

name: head-rgbd-applied-calibration
note: head_camera_cpp camera_info_file and head_rgbd_cpp tof_calibration_file point at /var/lib/ros2/head_rgbd_calibration/applied/*; committed repo calibration files only seed an empty applied/ (force: false); head_rgbd_cpp config_files entry removed; owner task head-nodes-use-applied-calib

name: head-rgbd-points
note: /head_rgbd/points: PointCloud2 XYZRGB (packed float32 rgb) in the RGB optical frame, RGB stamp, <= cloud.rate_hz (1 Hz), published while subscribed; consumed by ground_estimator_cpp colour labels (task ground-node-wiring)

name: tof-points-filtered
note: /tof/points_filtered: laser_filter self-filtered ToF cloud, tof_optical_frame, ~10 Hz, reliable; ground_estimator_cpp input and ground_clear frustum source (tasks ground-node-wiring, nav2-ground-voxel-layer)

name: nav2-tof-voxel-bands
note: tof_voxel_layer sources/bands and collision_monitor tof_obstacles/tof_cliff stay unchanged; ground_voxel_layer is added alongside; tests/test_nav_tof_voxel_layer.py and tests/test_tof_obstacle_wiring.py checks scoped to tof_voxel_layer (task nav2-ground-voxel-layer)

name: arm-calibration-stale-marker
note: /var/lib/ros2/arm/calibration_stale.json {version:1, group, saved_at, joints:{name:{before_steps,after_steps}}, stale:[joint_offsets, home]}; writer feetech bridge after an arm neutral save; mcp_server removes home on arm_set_home; the arm calibration apply removes joint_offsets; empty list deletes the file; owner task bridge-runtime-neutral-save

name: servo-torque-state-topic
note: /{ns}/torque_state std_msgs/String JSON, reliable transient_local depth 1: {namespace, released, joints:{name:0|1}, stamp_ns, neutral_enabled, neutral_capture, last_save}; ns follower|swerve_drive|head; arm calibration must refuse while follower released; owner tasks bridge-torque-services-topic, bridge-runtime-neutral-save

name: calibration-config-servos-flag
note: GET /api/calibration/config gains servos: bool; CalibratePage.tsx renders the Servo torque and neutral section (calibrate/ServoNeutral.tsx) before the arm placeholder; owner tasks web-ui-servo-routes, calibrate-page-servo-section

name: head-chain-override
note: head_chain.json format and apply_overrides; moved from head-and-arm-calibration-fro 2026-10-21 (user D1 quick fit first)

name: tof-depth-z
note: /tof/depth/image_raw 16UC1 mm is z-depth (SDK radial distance / ray norm of the calibrated ToF K, no distortion); /tof/camera_info K = tof_calibration_file K (SDK K fallback), D zero; owner task tof-radial-to-z-depth

name: head-pan-sign
note: base_servos head group: head_pan inverted true (servo mounted reversed, found 2026-10-21); +pan = left CCW from above, URDF unchanged, steps 1024..3072; owner task head-pan-inverted

name: tof-mark-band
note: tof_voxel_layer tof_mark min_obstacle_height and collision_monitor tof_obstacles min_height 0.10 m (was 0.06, supersedes that value of nav2-tof-voxel-bands); mcp perception TOF_OBSTACLE_BAND_M (0.10, 0.6); owner task tof-mark-band-ten-cm

name: imu-data-rate
note: /imu/data from bno055_imu at 25 Hz (publish_hz 25, was 50); every consumer's IMU staleness limit stays >= 3 periods (0.12 s), pinned by tests/test_client_cpu_load.py; owner task imu-publish-rate-25-hz

name: head-camera-stream-rate
note: /head_camera/image_raw(/compressed) at 15 fps (head_camera_cpp frame_duration_us 66666, code default 33333 unchanged); mapping stream rate_hz and marker_detector process_hz stay <= 15; owner task head-camera-15-fps

name: rgbd-pose-hints
note: rgbd pose.json gains hints: [str] (capture_hints, shared hints.py); GET /api/sessions/{sid} poses[].hints computed for older poses; fixture tests/fixtures/api/session.json; rgbd sessions only; owner task capture-corner-hints

name: rgbd-result-pose-errors
note: rgbd result.json gains poses: [{id, rgb_error_px, tof_error_px, stereo_error_px, outlier}] and outlier_poses: [id], empty on input errors; fixture tests/fixtures/api/result.json; frontend guards treat them as optional; owner task compute-result-pose-errors

name: urdf-chain-fk
note: UrdfChain FK core; moved from head-and-arm-calibration-fro 2026-10-21

name: head-chain-applied-record
note: applied/head_chain.json is the source of truth for the applied chain; applied.json gains head_chain {session, result, applied_at}; head-and-arm head-chain-compute-apply must keep both

name: ground-traversability-rule
note: obstacle when edge step (p50 of the edge band) > 1/3 wheel diameter (0.04 m) or a measurable slope > traversability.max_slope_deg 15 (<= min tilt_guard roll/pitch error limits); colour clusters warning-only; lethal marks need lethal_min_points and hysteresis.enter_frames of hysteresis.window_frames; owner task slope-and-smoothing-defaults

name: tof-depth-flying-pixel-filter
note: /tof/depth/image_raw: pixels at depth discontinuities (a valid 3x3 neighbour differing by more than max(flying_pixel_min_jump_mm, flying_pixel_jump_ratio * depth)) are published as 0 (invalid, REP 118) when flying_pixel_filter is true (default); flat floor 0.3-2.0 m keeps >= 95 %; counter tof_flying_pixels_removed_total; owner task tof-flying-pixel-filter

name: head-arm-fit
note: fit_head_from_arm, HeadArmFit, aim_head; owner task head-from-arm-board-solver

name: head-arm-calib-api
note: /api/head-arm/* routes and fixtures head_arm_state/result/sessions.json; owner task head-arm-sequence-http-api

name: calib-session-kinds
note: session kind head_arm, add_still_pose pose.json {stamps, rgb, joints (7), arm_pose, tier, head_offset}; owner task session-kinds-joint-poses

name: arm-pose-check
note: PoseChecker.check_pose/check_path with the board on the gripper; owner task arm-pose-safety-check
